scope: Snapshot of the posted public rules, not a match-specific historical policy version. Confirm historical or event-specific exceptions with the organizer.
banned_weapons_and_attachments: Thermite-reload attachments for snipers and marksman rifles

policies.report: Screenshot the player's name and evidence of the banned item or class. Send it to an organizer.
policies.smrs: The victim receives the kill points. The offending player receives one warning.
policies.warnings: A player who receives three warnings is suspended from scrims for two weeks.
policies.fixed_slots: Your slot is permanent until an organizer reassigns it. Contact an organizer to request a change.
policies.wrong_slot: Playing outside your assigned slot, including in another team's slot, means no points for your team for that entire game.
policies.report_slot_misuse: If another team takes your slot, screenshot their names and report it to an organizer.
